verdict.rationale: The pack never documents Decagon connecting to or ingesting help-center articles, documentation, or internal wikis as agent knowledge sources. The nearby features do something different: Duet mines past interactions to generate AOPs (procedures), and Suggestions drafts new help-center content from gaps. Neither shows the agent being grounded on existing knowledge without re-authoring, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the agent ingests my help center, docs, past tickets, and internal wikis as knowledge sources without manual re-authoring
